note: Cram skeleton: one entry per bank. A panel shows only while Date.now() < until and CalcCoach.FLAGS.hailMary is true. Generic study moves, no exam stems.

BANK_P3X.title: Stuck? Hail Mary
BANK_P3X.promo: Stuck on one? Hail Mary: 4 moves for a smart guess.
BANK_P3X.intro: You lose nothing for a wrong bubble. Fill in every one.

cards.b: Round each number to one digit and use g = 10. Cross off any choice far from your guess.
cards.ex: Example: F = ma with m = 4.9 kg and a = 9.8. You think 5 × 10 = 50. Keep 48, cross off 4.8 and 480.

cards.b: Cross off a number copied from the question. The middle, biggest, or odd one is luck.
cards.ex: Example: a 12 kg box gets a 36 N push. Find a. Cross off 12 and 36. They are copied.

cards.b: Count the letters you trust. Pick the letter you used least.
cards.ex: Example: your sure answers are A, B, B, D, A, D. You used C zero times. Pick C.

cards.b: Fill every bubble. A blank is always wrong.
cards.ex: Example: 1 bubble is empty and 30 s are left. Fill C. You now have a 1 in 5 shot, not 0.

BANK_P3X.odds: Blind pick: 1 in 5. These moves: about 1 in 2.

constants.title: Constants for this exam
constants.intro: Look them up on your calculator instead of typing digits from memory. These are the ones Exam 3 needs.

casio: Your Casio cover often has the constant list printed inside. Check it before the exam.
Worst case: press SHIFT 7, then try numbers until the symbol you need shows up. There are only 40.
